Vendored subset of Gel
======================

This directory contains the part of the `Gel <https://github.com/geldata/gel>`_
server (formerly EdgeDB) that is needed to compile a schema and to compile
EdgeQL queries to SQL, i.e. everything that is imported by ``run_benchmark.py``:

* ``edb.edgeql``: the EdgeQL/SDL grammar and parser, and the compiler from
  EdgeQL AST to the intermediate representation (IR);
* ``edb.ir``: the IR itself and the analyses on it;
* ``edb.schema``: the schema, the schema objects and the DDL machinery;
* ``edb.pgsql``: the compiler from IR to SQL AST and the SQL code generator;
* ``edb.lib``: the standard library of Gel, written in EdgeQL;
* ``edb.common``, ``edb.errors``, ``edb.server.config``: support code.

The code was extracted from the ``master`` branch of Gel at the commit
``85191063b4db8b87caf26499de40f8a9d90c8146`` (2025-12-23).  The rest of
the ``edb`` package (the server itself, the protocol implementations, the SQL
adapter, the PostgreSQL backend support, the tools and the tests) was removed.

Gel is licensed under the Apache License 2.0, see ``LICENSE`` and ``NOTICE``.


Differences from upstream
-------------------------

The Python code of Gel is used as is, with one exception listed below.  It
runs unmodified on Python 3.12 to 3.15.

Gel depends on a number of extension modules written in Rust and Cython.
To make this a benchmark of the Python interpreter rather than of those, and
to make it possible to run it on any Python implementation, the ones needed by
the compilers were replaced with pure-Python equivalents providing the same API:

``edb/_edgeql_parser.py`` (new)
    Replaces the ``edb._edgeql_parser`` Rust extension (the ``edb/edgeql-parser``
    crate).  This is a port of the EdgeQL tokenizer and of the LR(1) parser
    driver to Python.  Unlike the original, the parser does not attempt to
    recover from syntax errors to produce better error messages: the first
    unexpected token is reported as an error.  Query normalization (extraction
    of constants), needed only by the server, is not implemented.

``edb/common/turbo_uuid.py`` (new)
    Replaces the ``edb.common.turbo_uuid`` Cython extension: a subclass of
    ``uuid.UUID``.

``immutables/`` (new)
    The pure-Python implementation of the HAMT-based immutable mapping from
    the `immutables <https://github.com/MagicStack/immutables>`_ package
    (version 0.21, Apache License 2.0), without the C accelerator.  Gel schemas
    are stored in these mappings.

``edb/edgeql/grammar.json.gz`` (new)
    The EdgeQL LR(1) parser tables, generated from the grammar definition
    in ``edb/edgeql/parser/grammar/`` by ``regen_grammar.py``.  Upstream
    generates the same data at build time and stores it in a binary format
    (``grammar.bc``).

``edb/edgeql/parser/__init__.py`` (modified)
    ``get_spec_filepath()`` returns the path to ``grammar.json.gz`` instead
    of ``grammar.bc``.

``edb/_buildmeta.py`` (new)
    Static build metadata (the version), generated by ``setup.py`` upstream.

The only third-party dependency is the pure-Python
`parsing <https://pypi.org/project/parsing/>`_ package, which is what the
EdgeQL grammar is defined with.


Updating
--------

To update the vendored code, copy the new versions of the files over from
a Gel checkout, check that no new modules are needed (the benchmarks fail
with an ``ImportError`` otherwise), re-apply the change to
``edb/edgeql/parser/__init__.py``, port the changes made to the Rust and Cython
extensions if any, and regenerate the parser tables::

    python regen_grammar.py

The tests of the compilers in the Gel repository that do not need a database
(``tests/test_edgeql_syntax.py``, ``tests/test_schema_syntax.py``,
``tests/test_edgeql_ir_*.py``, ``tests/test_edgeql_sql_codegen.py`` and
``tests/test_schema.py``) can be used to check the result.
